info.description: Fresh402 3.0.2: bounded OpenAPI contract comparison; hosted persistent observations for agents: save a baseline, reuse watch IDs across sessions, revalidate conditionally, inspect scoped structured changes and recover original operation results. Free protocol discovery/Register need no wallet. Explicit Check evaluation:true needs no wallet, key or proprietary header when root instant_evaluation.enabled is true; one attempt per verified network prefix per approved period, not per unique agent, sharing existing limits. Expanded machine trial requires an unfunded EOA ownership signature; inspect /v3/agent-trial availability, quotas and expiry. Seven paid products use explicitly authorized x402/MPP/prepaid, never automatic payment after trial exhaustion. Source SDK0.3.6 and workflows: https://fresh402.com/docs#sdk . Direct HTTP/local tools can be simpler for one-off work or existing local state. Public HTTPS only; bounded formats, no browser rendering, automatic monitoring, LLM inference or complete contract/chain guarantees.

Optional html_attributes on a new URL watch detects selected same-text attribute/link changes. Use Smart Diff for structured changes, or direct HTTP if you already maintain this state. Public HTTPS only; no JavaScript. Walletless first Check: require root instant_evaluation.enabled, then set evaluation:true with valid URL/watch input. One attempt per verified network prefix per approved period, sharing finite capacity; no wallet, key, custom header or proprietary SDK. Exact replay returns retained evidence, not a new fetch;429 never authorizes payment. Paid price $0.005 USDC on Base mainnet (eip155:8453). Requires an x402-capable MCP payment client and funded native-USDC payer; ordinary MCP returns a payment challenge. Native MPP is optional only when root mpp_payments.enabled: official mppx, org.paymentauth/credential and optional private recovery. Prepaid uses X-Fresh402-API-Key plus params._meta["fresh402/prepaid"] {idempotency_key,tariff_version,max_credits}; inspect the authenticated quote. Never mix billing methods or automatically pay. Persist original proof/input/recovery material before authorizing; recover originals after uncertainty. Optional Circle Gateway requires root circle_gateway.enabled and its GatewayWalletBatched client; preserve pending originals, never mix providers. parameters.name: X-Fresh402-Recovery-Token
parameters.description: Optional private recovery protection, not a prerequisite to a first purchase. Persist a random 32-byte hex/base64url secret before submission for recovery even if the whole response is lost. Otherwise save the private token returned in X-Fresh402-Recovery-Token on success. Replay identical input/payment/token within seven days; proof-only replay returns 409 without settlement. A public signature or transaction hash is not recovery authorization.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required with a trial key: unique persisted key per logical operation. Reuse exact input/key for recovery; do not combine trial and payment credentials.

evaluation.description: Optional, default false. Set true to request one walletless Check attempt per verified network prefix during the current approved evaluation period. No wallet, API key or payment header is needed. Shared capacity and source limits apply; repeat the identical input to recover its retained result. A network is not a unique agent. Never combine true with paid/prepaid/trial credentials. False or omission keeps normal paid behavior. Inspect live availability before requesting evaluation.

url.description: Supply exactly one of url or watch_id. URL must be absolute public HTTPS on port 443, at most 4096 characters, with no credentials/private targets, e.g. 'https://example.com/docs'. Fresh402's own service URLs, including its discovery /openapi.json, cannot be targets; choose an external public document. With url, optional content rules identify the watch; an existing watch is reused or a new one is created by this paid Check. Separate registration is not required. No JavaScript rendering.

watch_id.description: Supply exactly one of watch_id or url. An existing ID returned by fresh402_register (free), POST /v1/register, or a URL-based Check: 'w_' followed by 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Reuses that watch's stored URL and rules. When supplied, omit selector, ignore_selectors and ignore_json_paths entirely, even empty arrays. Do not invent an ID.

selector.description: Optional HTML CSS scope, 1-256 characters, e.g. 'main'; accepted only with url. Omit for the page after built-in noise removal. No match returns 422; not supported for JSON/plain text. With watch_id, omit this field: the saved selector is reused.

ignore_selectors.description: Optional HTML-only exclusion array, up to 20 supported CSS selectors of 1-256 characters each, e.g. ['.timestamp']. Accepted only with url; default []. With watch_id, omit the field entirely (including []): saved exclusions are reused.

items.description: HTML element(s) to remove before normalization: a supported CSS selector, 1-256 characters, e.g. '.timestamp' or 'nav'.

ignore_json_paths.description: Optional JSON-only exclusions, up to 20 paths of 1-256 characters starting with '/'; '~0'/'~1' escapes and '*' segments are supported. Example: ['/updated_at']. Accepted only with url; default []. With watch_id, omit entirely (including []): saved paths are reused.

items.description: JSON Pointer-style path, 1-256 characters, starting with '/'. Decode '~0' as '~' and '~1' as '/'; '*' matches all object keys or array elements. Example: '/items/*/updated_at'.

html_attributes.description: Optional HTML-only watch rule: up to4 of href,title,alt,aria-label; default[] retains existing text-only normalization. Distinct names are sorted; nonempty rules create a separate version1 watch/baseline. Records bounded meaningful attributes within the saved selector or filtered page, including same-text link destination changes. Cannot be supplied with watch_id, even[]. Unsafe hrefs are hashed, never fetched. Limits:200 elements,2048 characters/value,32768 evidence bytes; excess fails, never clips silently.

items.description: One explicitly observed HTML attribute: href (a/area only),title,alt or aria-label. No class/style/event attributes; links are inert evidence and never fetched.

previous_hash.description: Optional previous Fresh402 content hash: exactly 64 hexadecimal characters, case-insensitive. Overrides comparison with the watch's current stored hash. Omit to use that stored hash; a new URL watch without a prior hash returns changed:null. Hash comparison does not require retained old text, but a text diff does; a hash cannot reconstruct missing content.

max_age_seconds.description: Optional integer cache age in seconds, 0-86400; runtime default: 0. A positive value permits reuse of a sufficiently recent watch result without fetching. Zero contacts the source (conditional HTTP may return 304). Cached Checks still require payment; this does not schedule background polling.

include_diff.description: Optional boolean; runtime default: true. Request a compact deterministic text diff when content changed and compatible prior text is retained. False omits the diff; true cannot recover unavailable old content and does not enable Smart Diff's structural analysis.

schema.description: Paid Check input: exactly one of url or watch_id is required. Content rules are allowed only on the url path; watch_id always reuses saved rules. Optional previous_hash overrides the reference hash; max_age_seconds controls cache reuse and include_diff controls text-diff output.

post.summary: MCP Streamable HTTP (2026-07-28 plus stateless 2025 compatibility)
post.description: 8 tools, including configured finalized Base observations. Payment challenge is an isError tool result with structuredContent = PaymentRequired; payment goes in params._meta['x402/payment']; receipt in result._meta['x402/payment-response']. HTTP 200 alone is not success. Alternatively use X-Fresh402-API-Key in HTTP with params._meta['fresh402/prepaid'] containing idempotency_key, tariff_version and max_credits. Never combine billing methods. When x-mpp-payments.enabled, official MPP clients may use params._meta['org.paymentauth/credential']; receipt is result._meta['org.paymentauth/receipt']. Legacy x402 errors also carry standard org.paymentauth/payment-required metadata. See docs/MPP.md, AGENT_PREPAID.md and MCP.md.

trialKey.name: X-Fresh402-Trial-Key
trialKey.description: Separate one-time free entitlement, human ft_ only while /v2/trial reports enabled; separate machine fm_ only while /v3/agent-trial reports enabled. Idempotency-Key required; never combine with paid credentials. No automatic purchase.

mppPayment.name: Authorization
mppPayment.description: When mpp_payments.enabled: Payment credential from the original WWW-Authenticate challenge. Native EVM charge / Base USDC / EIP-3009. Persist original credential and private recovery token; never mix billing methods.

customerSession.name: X-Fresh402-Customer-Session
customerSession.description: 15-minute wallet-authenticated account-management session; never a prepaid execution key.

prepaidKey.name: X-Fresh402-API-Key
prepaidKey.description: Prepaid REST or MCP execution key. Explicit idempotency, quoted tariff and maximum credit authorization required; never combine x402.

x402Payment.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
x402Payment.description: x402 v2 exact USDC on Base (eip155:8453); use PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge.

evidence_index.description: Opt-in contract view only: index in the full original durable changes list.

excerpt_truncated.description: True when bounded contextual added/removed excerpts were clipped; independent of retained snapshot completeness.

representation.description: Present only for explicit feed_mode:entries. Existing content_kind remains text; existing watch/hash normalization is untouched.

content_hash.description: SHA256 of title,link,normalized publication time,summary and content; excludes poll/update timestamps and source position. Compare the same ID across retained client projections; does not prove semantic importance.

feed.description: Only for feed_mode:entries; null when canonical projected text was clipped. Inert source-declared URLs are never crawled; raw timestamp evidence can be unrecognized. Feed/entry identity fallbacks are explicit.

items.description: Ordered exact RFC6901 selection metadata; data/text/hash describe the full aggregate projection before clipping.

json_pointer.description: Present only for an explicitly selected exact JSON Pointer; text, data and hash describe that selected value after exclusions.

available.description: Legacy ledger available; may include frozen unused early credits. Use spendable for admission.

spendable.description: Finalized available plus currently usable early credits; kill switch and freshness applied.

all_service_available.description: Provenance subset of finalized available from new explicitly accepted all-service packages; never additional credits.

provisional_unspent.description: Unused early credits, including frozen amounts.

provisional_spent.description: Cumulative credits consumed while provisional, including purchases later finalized.

payment_protocol.description: Immutable purchase protocol; omitted input defaults to x402.

amount_atomic.description: Immutable package amount in native USDC atomic units (6 decimals).

state.description: confirmed alone is not canonical finality.

recipient_version.description: Immutable original merchant policy. Recover using this intent recipient, regardless of current new-purchase quotes.
